gloss: to get on track; to get going smoothly

definitions.gloss: to get on track; to get into full swing; to start running smoothly
definitions.explanation: Used when a project, business, plan, or activity passes its initial difficulties and begins to operate steadily and successfully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}った。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}り⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The plan is finally starting to get on track.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took half a year for my new life to get into a steady rhythm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}り、⟦{黒字|くろじ}→黒字：04715_kuroji⟧になった。
examples.english: Three months after opening, the management got on track and turned profitable.

notes:
Literally 'to ride on a track/orbit.' The metaphor compares a smoothly running operation to a train on its tracks or a satellite in orbit. Very commonly used in business and project contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}る: the business gets on track
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}る: management gets on track
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}る: the plan gets on track
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}る: life settles into a routine
- ⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧: to put on track (transitive form)

USAGE:
The transitive counterpart ⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧ means 'to put something on track' — i.e., to make a project start running smoothly through one's efforts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to proceed smoothly — describes ongoing smooth progress, while {軌道|きどう}に{乗|の}る marks the transition from struggle to stability
- ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a wave; to get into a groove — more casual, emphasizes momentum
